The progressive 24/7 lenses that provide clear vision all day, every day. From the trusted lens manufacturer Bausch & Lomb, PureVision2 for Presbyopia offers superior comfort while correcting presbyopia. Designed to enhance both near and intermediate vision without compromising distance vision, these lenses deliver a seamless visual experience. Right from the first blink, PureVision2 for Presbyopia ensures exceptional comfort with its moisture-enriched packaging solution, making lens insertion a breeze. The thin design and rounded edges provide a smooth transition from the conjunctiva to the lens surface, offering unmatched comfort without compromises. Equipped with advanced HD optics, PureVision2 for Presbyopia reduces glare and halos, enhancing visual sharpness and low-light visibility by minimizing spherical aberration. The thinner design also sets PureVision2 for Presbyopia apart, offering significantly more comfort compared to its predecessor, PureVision Multi-Focal. As multifocal contact lenses from Bausch & Lomb, PureVision2 for Presbyopia effortlessly adapts to your eyes. The ultra-thin, rounded edges make them incredibly comfortable for extended wear, even up to 30 days – allowing you to keep them on even while sleeping.

Experience unparalleled comfort and clear vision with ACUVUE OASYS® 1-DAY for Astigmatism 30-pack with HydraLuxe™  – toric daily lenses designed for optimal performance.
These daily lenses combat the feeling of tired eyes, making them ideal for demanding environments. Equipped with advanced lens technology, ACUVUE OASYS® 1-Day for Astigmatism ensures sharp and stable vision regardless of your daily activities.

Moreover, they feature a Class 1 UV-blocking capability, providing protection against harmful sun rays. Initiate your new reusable contact lens journey with ACUVUE OASYS® Contact Lenses for astigmatism, backed by 15 years of clinical studies showcasing unbeaten comfort. ACUVUE OASYS® is the world's #1 selling contact lens, offering stability during various life activities. These lenses block approximately 96.1% of UVA rays and over 99.9% of UVB rays. The HYDRACLEAR® PLUS Technology ensures a stable tear film with a wetting agent mimicking mucins.


ACUVUE OASYS® 1-Day for Astigmatism, designed for daily use, should be discarded after each wear. Always follow your optometrist's recommendations for usage and handling. If you encounter any issues with your lenses, first ensure proper usage, then contact our customer service or your optometrist for guidance.

These lenses are available in convenient 30 and 90-pack options.

A Glimpse into History

The Puma Army Trainer holds a disputed yet fascinating history, rooted in its origins as the German Army Trainer (GAT). Designed in the 1970s for indoor training of the German armed forces, this iconic shoe was crafted with a rubber sole for traction and an all-leather body for optimal comfort during rigorous exercises.

 From Military Precision to Timeless Fashion

What's certain is that the design, born out of military necessity, seamlessly transitioned from the barracks to the runways of fashion. Like many other pieces, the Puma Army Trainer made its mark on the fashion scene, becoming an enduring style that transcends trends.

Today, Puma proudly reissues this vintage icon from its archives, maintaining the simplicity and timeless appeal that defines the Puma Army Trainer. It's not just a shoe; it's a historical reimagining, a nod to the roots that shaped its enduring style.

True to the Original

This execution stays true to the original design, featuring a leather upper with a suede toe overlay. Every detail is a tribute to the authenticity of the German Army Trainer, ensuring that the reissued Puma Army Trainer captures the essence of its historical counterpart.

Material Information

Crafted with precision, the leather upper and suede toe overlay not only pay homage to the past but also ensure a comfortable and durable fit. It's a blend of history and modern craftsmanship, creating a shoe that stands the test of time.

 Embrace the Enduring Style

The Puma Army Trainer isn't just a shoe with a storied past; it's an invitation to embrace enduring style. Step into history, walk with authenticity, and make a statement that goes beyond fashion trends with the timeless appeal of Puma's reissued vintage icon.

Drawing inspiration from the dynamic energy of [[DAYTONA]] city, these trainers showcase a distinctive and stylish color palette, merging serene grey and blue tones with vibrant accents of yellow, orange, and green. Crafted from a blend of leather, textile, and rubber, they exude authenticity while offering a versatile design to complement any ensemble. Featuring mesh detailing on the front for added breathability and comfort, along with a memory foam insole, these trainers ensure a comfortable stride throughout the day. Each sole encapsulates a unique essence, adding a touch of urban sophistication to elevate your outfits effortlessly.

The [[CITY]] silhouette is the brand's icon, inspired by 90's sneakers. These sneakers take us to the most important cities in the world, thanks to the sole that includes emblematic places.
We love the classic, versatile design and the leaf-shaped logo on the side.

4-way stretch woven running pants with zip sidepockets, back yoke, inside drawstring & silver reflective print

The Puma Army Trainer holds a disputed yet fascinating history, rooted in its origins as the German Army Trainer (GAT). Designed in the 1970s for indoor training of the German armed forces, this iconic shoe was crafted with a rubber sole for traction and an all-leather body for optimal comfort during rigorous exercises.

 From Military Precision to Timeless Fashion

What's certain is that the design, born out of military necessity, seamlessly transitioned from the barracks to the runways of fashion. Like many other pieces, the Puma Army Trainer made its mark on the fashion scene, becoming an enduring style that transcends trends.

Today, Puma proudly reissues this vintage icon from its archives, maintaining the simplicity and timeless appeal that defines the Puma Army Trainer. It's not just a shoe; it's a historical reimagining, a nod to the roots that shaped its enduring style.

True to the Original

This execution stays true to the original design, featuring a leather upper with a suede toe overlay. Every detail is a tribute to the authenticity of the German Army Trainer, ensuring that the reissued Puma Army Trainer captures the essence of its historical counterpart.

The progressive 24/7 lenses that provide clear vision all day, every day. From the trusted lens manufacturer Bausch & Lomb, PureVision2 for Presbyopia offers superior comfort while correcting presbyopia. Designed to enhance both near and intermediate vision without compromising distance vision, these lenses deliver a seamless visual experience. Right from the first blink, PureVision2 for Presbyopia ensures exceptional comfort with its moisture-enriched packaging solution, making lens insertion a breeze. The thin design and rounded edges provide a smooth transition from the conjunctiva to the lens surface, offering unmatched comfort without compromises. Equipped with advanced HD optics, PureVision2 for Presbyopia reduces glare and halos, enhancing visual sharpness and low-light visibility by minimizing spherical aberration. The thinner design also sets PureVision2 for Presbyopia apart, offering significantly more comfort compared to its predecessor, PureVision Multi-Focal. As multifocal contact lenses from Bausch & Lomb, PureVision2 for Presbyopia effortlessly adapts to your eyes. The ultra-thin, rounded edges make them incredibly comfortable for extended wear, even up to 30 days – allowing you to keep them on even while sleeping.
